title: The Cartographer's Grief
description: The world remembers your deaths. Grief Skulls mark every place you fell, upgrading to Obelisks after 7 in-game days. Craft Memory Shards into exploration tools and watch your Wanderlust bar fill as you discover new chunks.
body:
## What's new in v1.1.1

- Fixed direction arrows now pointing correctly from player to location for both Memory Orb recall and Grief Map entries. Fixed Memory Orb named label display when using a custom-named orb.

## The Cartographer's Grief

The world remembers your deaths.

Every time you die, a glowing **Grief Skull** block is placed at your exact death location. Right-click it to read who died there and how. After **7 in-game days** (168,000 ticks), it silently upgrades into a taller, brighter **Obelisk** — a permanent monument to that moment.

Break a Grief Skull to collect **Memory Shards**, the currency of this mod.

---

### Items

**Memory Shard** — drops from Grief Skulls and Obelisks. Used in all crafting recipes.

**Memory Orb** (Memory Shard + Ender Pearl) — right-click once to save your current position. Right-click again anywhere to see the exact coordinates and distance back. Works across dimensions with a warning.

**Wanderer's Compass** (Compass + 4 Memory Shards) — points toward the nearest uncharted structure: villages, ruins, outposts, shipwrecks, and more. Prints the direction and distance in chat.

---

### Wanderlust HUD

A slim bar at the top of your screen fills as you explore new chunks, up to 500 unique chunks tracked. It pulses with a soft glow when full. Persisted per world and server.

---

### Required on both sides

This mod registers custom blocks and world data, so both client and server need it installed.
